sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:42

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:42:1
items.html: Ohr Ein Sof descended and fissured in them from above downward. This refers to the new Ohr that came down and fissured the Parsa and the Ohr for Nekudim, as the Rav says. Also, fissuring means the annulment of the Gevul.
